mentions.name: KaosEngine
mentions.description: A platform that generates full-stack multiplayer game code from natural-language descriptions, pairing an AI-assisted game builder with the KaosEngine real-time multiplayer backend. The backend is Rust-powered with WebSocket and RUDP networking using fast ring buffers, plus matchmaking, a Lua runtime with hot-reload, leaderboards, storage, chat, rooms and social features (friends, etc.). SDKs are available for Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, Unity, Godot and Defold. The Game Studio offers a Monaco-based Lua/HTML IDE, live preview with hot-reload for backend and frontend, chat-based iteration, GitHub sync, and one-click deploy. A Discord and public playground for early access are planned.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building a platform that lets you describe a multiplayer game idea in natural language and generates full-stack code for it—frontend (PixiJS, Phaser, Babylon, or Three.js) plus backend (KaosEngine real-time multiplayer framework). You can iterate via chat, preview live, sync to GitHub, and deploy.
